systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development
systems.tiers: Decentralised to 22 Ministry Zonal Offices; not rolled out to district or sub-county authorities, where District Land Offices keep land records manually and certificates of customary ownership are typewritten and stored on paper at sub-county level (World Bank, 2024)

note: The only system is the ministry's land information system, used at the ministry's zonal offices and stated as absent from district and sub-county authorities; that is an application absence, not a statement on the office's connection, so no fact.
